content.short: Clique is a confidential computing infrastructure provider that enables secure data attestation and identity verification for decentralized applications.
content.description: Clique leverages advanced technologies like TEE, MPC, and Zero-Knowledge Proofs to provide a robust layer for confidential data and identity management. By offering secure attestation services, Clique allows protocols to verify user contributions and maintain sybil-resistance without compromising individual privacy. On the Mantle Network, Clique serves as a foundational piece of infrastructure for building private, secure, and trustless identity-based rewards systems.
content.meta: Clique provides secure identity attestation and confidential computing for the Mantle ecosystem. Discover Clique on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
